# Rich-Dons Catering

> Fresh Ghanaian food delivery and catering in Accra, Ghana.

Official website: https://richdonscatering.com

## Public pages

- [Menu and online ordering](https://richdonscatering.com/menu): Browse Ghanaian dishes, descriptions, and prices.
- [Event catering](https://richdonscatering.com/events): Make an event catering inquiry.
- [Corporate catering](https://richdonscatering.com/corporate): Information and ordering for office lunch service.

## Service area

Accra and the Greater Accra Region, Ghana.
